listing.name: Blue Stinger — BlueStingerRecomp (rodrigo-mendonca)
listing.summary: Actual game/native audio/Vulkan rendering described; intermittent AMD device-lost and unfixed fog/modifier volumes; remaster work not implemented. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own NTSC-U T13001N V1.000 1999-07-05 CDI. Check the project’s exact 1ST_READ.BIN SHA-256 requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the CMake/MSVC source route or BlueStinger Builder/Recompiler instructions to generate a native executable and game data from your own CDI. The remastered installer edition remains planned.

warnings: Actual game/native audio/Vulkan rendering described; intermittent AMD device-lost and unfixed fog/modifier volumes; remaster work not implemented.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.

decisions.rationale: The repository moved from rodrigo-mendonca to DCRecomp. GitHub only lets an administrator of the original repository transfer it, and rodrigo-mendonca authored its history and remains a contributor. Keep the Portcove identity and listing; only its project location changes.
